Detect the format of identifiers

Source: R/detect.R
id_detect.Rd

id_detect() names the format of each element, or gives NA when the evidence does not settle it. Detection never guesses:

Usage

id_detect(x, hint = NULL, layout = NULL)

Arguments

x

A character vector.

hint

NULL, or the formats to try.

layout

An id_layout() for Snowflake or SCRU64.

Value

A character vector of formats, NA where none or several fit, with the attribute candidates: a list of the formats each element passes, structured formats first.

Details

  • Without a hint, only structured formats are tried, since an encoding or a syntactic format (NanoID, Cuid2, Sqids) matches any string over its alphabet. A UUID written in Crockford base32 is textually a ULID, and the ULID is what is detected; id_parse(x, "uuid", form = "base32") is how to say otherwise.

  • When exactly one format passes at the "structure" level, it is the answer. When several pass, the answer is NA, and the candidates attribute lists them. A 26-character lowercase Crockford string, for one, is a ULID or a TypeID without a prefix.

  • A Snowflake is considered only under a Snowflake layout, since every layout reads the digits differently. A SCRU64 is listed among the candidates, but chosen only under id_layout("scru64", node_bits = ).

  • hint restricts the formats tried to those named, and is how a syntactic format or an encoding can be detected at all.

Formats are recognised in their canonical text, with their default alphabets.

Examples

id_detect(c(
  "018f6b1c-2d3e-7a4b-8c5d-6e7f8091a2b3",
  "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
  "01arz3ndektsv4rrffq69g5fav",
  "not an id"
))
#> [1] "uuid" "ulid" NA     NA    
#> attr(,"candidates")
#> attr(,"candidates")[[1]]
#> [1] "uuid"
#> 
#> attr(,"candidates")[[2]]
#> [1] "ulid"
#> 
#> attr(,"candidates")[[3]]
#> [1] "ulid"   "typeid"
#> 
#> attr(,"candidates")[[4]]
#> character(0)
#> 
id_detect("01arz3ndektsv4rrffq69g5fav", hint = "typeid")
#> [1] "typeid"
#> attr(,"candidates")
#> attr(,"candidates")[[1]]
#> [1] "typeid"
#> 
id_detect("175928847299117063", layout = id_layout("discord"))
#> [1] "snowflake"
#> attr(,"candidates")
#> attr(,"candidates")[[1]]
#> [1] "snowflake"
#>
